bearing_supplier_identity.reason: Assumed isotropic stiffness/damping; no catalogue part.

fia_question: Are critical speeds clear of the 19,500 rpm operating band with margin?

geometry_provenance.statement: Kit-sized ROSS beam model from twin housing/rotor dimensions; not the generic ross_rotor_selftest 1 m shaft.

margins.note: Screening margin only — assumed bearing stiffness/damping and steel equivalent disk. Not a supplier Campbell diagram.

modal_or_dynamometer_correlation.statement: Critical-speed prediction still requires modal test and/or dynamometer coast-down correlation on the current hardware revision.

model_assumptions: Solid steel shaft OD equals rotor bore (or fpk_shaft_od_mm when present).
Bearing span equals housing length (or fpk_bearing_span_mm when present).
6 equal beam elements span the bearings.
One midspan DiskElement approximates laminated rotor + magnets as steel.
Bearing kxx=5.000e+07 N/m, cxx=5.000e+03 N·s/m (isotropic, identical ends).
No gear overhang, resolver stub, differential shafts, or housing flexibility.
No gyroscopic speed sweep / unbalance response / squeeze-film dampers.
release_statement: Concept evidence only. No FIA homologation, team interface closure, race evidence or permission to ship. Never claim PASS without dyno or modal correlation.
